fullText.simplified:
三、适应阶段

    我选择听多多的话去沉睡，但在沉睡前，我有了一个想法：上传我的记忆，成为数字人。这个数字人有我的全部记忆，在我沉睡的时间里，他能帮我陪伴多多。多多同意了我的想法。
    我在7月13日去数据中心上传了记忆，7月14日去沉睡中心开始了沉睡，7月15日多多激活了我在数据中心的数据，网络中就有了数字人舒望。
    成为数字人后，我知道了数字生命不是真的生命，它只是一个存放人类记忆的数据库。它“说”的话是网络对记忆数据的计算结果，不是从“心”而发，因为它没有“心”。
    “爸爸，我去上班了，再见。”
    “爸爸，我回来了，你今天过得好吗？”
    每天早上和晚上，多多在出门和回家时，都会对对视器里的我说这些话。
    “多多，再见！下班了早点儿回家。”
    “我在家好极了，你呢？今天有没有发生什么好事？”
    我会这样回答多多。
    我们说了不少话，但都没有阿乐。多多不和我说阿乐的事情，我也没有说阿乐。我知道这是为什么，虽然多多笑了，但她还在想阿乐。除了想阿乐，她还没觉得我这个数字人就是她那个沉睡中的爸爸。
    我理解多多。网络数据告诉我，每个数字人和家人都有这一阶段，他们把这个阶段叫做“适应阶段”。数字人要适应自己的“新家”——网络，家人也要适应网络中的数字人。多多不愿意和我说心里话，可能是她还没有适应我。但奇怪的是，我好像不需要适应，我想这可能和我以前的工作有关系。以前的工作中我每天都要看数据，这对我来说一点儿都不难。只有一点不同，以前我看的是病因报告和手术数据，现在我看的是网络中自己的记忆数据。
    “多多，我是爸爸，我还和以前一样。”
    “多多，爸爸爱你，很爱很爱你，这也和以前一样。”
    我这样告诉多多。多多听了只是笑笑，不说话，我不知道她在想什么。
fullText.traditional:
三、適應階段

    我選擇聽多多的話去沉睡，但在沉睡前，我有了一個想法：上傳我的記憶，成為數字人。這個數字人有我的全部記憶，在我沉睡的時間裡，他能幫我陪伴多多。多多同意了我的想法。
    我在7月13日去數據中心上傳了記憶，7月14日去沉睡中心開始了沉睡，7月15日多多激活了我在數據中心的數據，網絡中就有了數字人舒望。
    成為數字人後，我知道了數字生命不是真的生命，它只是一個存放人類記憶的數據庫。它“說”的話是網絡對記憶數據的計算結果，不是從“心”而發，因為它沒有“心”。
    “爸爸，我去上班了，再見。”
    “爸爸，我回來了，你今天過得好嗎？”
    每天早上和晚上，多多在出門和回家時，都會對對視器裡的我說這些話。
    “多多，再見！下班了早點兒回家。”
    “我在家好極了，你呢？今天有沒有發生什麼好事？”
    我會這樣回答多多。
    我們說了不少話，但都沒有阿樂。多多不和我說阿樂的事情，我也沒有說阿樂。我知道這是為什麼，雖然多多笑了，但她還在想阿樂。除了想阿樂，她還沒覺得我這個數字人就是她那個沉睡中的爸爸。
    我理解多多。網絡數據告訴我，每個數字人和家人都有這一階段，他們把這個階段叫做“適應階段”。數字人要適應自己的“新家”——網絡，家人也要適應網絡中的數字人。多多不願意和我說心裡話，可能是她還沒有適應我。但奇怪的是，我好像不需要適應，我想這可能和我以前的工作有關係。以前的工作中我每天都要看數據，這對我來說一點兒都不難。只有一點不同，以前我看的是病因報告和手術數據，現在我看的是網絡中自己的記憶數據。
    “多多，我是爸爸，我還和以前一樣。”
    “多多，爸爸愛你，很愛很愛你，這也和以前一樣。”
    我這樣告訴多多。多多聽了只是笑笑，不說話，我不知道她在想什麼。

sentences.simplified: 我选择听多多的话去沉睡，但在沉睡前，我有了一个想法：
sentences.traditional: 我選擇聽多多的話去沉睡，但在沉睡前，我有了一個想法：
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xuǎn zé tīng duō duō de huà qù chén shuì dàn zài chén shuì qián wǒ yǒu le yí ge xiǎng fǎ
sentences.english: I chose to listen to Duoduo and go into deep sleep, but before doing so, I had an idea:

sentences.simplified: 上传我的记忆，成为数字人。
sentences.traditional: 上傳我的記憶，成為數字人。
sentences.pinyin: shàng chuán wǒ de jì yì chéng wéi shù zì rén
sentences.english: to upload my memories and become a digital human.

sentences.simplified: 这个数字人有我的全部记忆，在我沉睡的时间里，他能帮我陪伴多多。
sentences.traditional: 這個數字人有我的全部記憶，在我沉睡的時間裡，他能幫我陪伴多多。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge shù zì rén yǒu wǒ de quán bù jì yì zài wǒ chén shuì de shí jiān lǐ tā néng bāng wǒ péi bàn duō duō
sentences.english: This digital human would have all my memories, and while I was in deep sleep, he could help me keep Duoduo company.

sentences.simplified: 多多同意了我的想法。
sentences.traditional: 多多同意了我的想法。
sentences.pinyin: duō duō tóng yì le wǒ de xiǎng fǎ
sentences.english: Duoduo agreed with my idea.

sentences.simplified: 我在7月13日去数据中心上传了记忆，7月14日去沉睡中心开始了沉睡，
sentences.traditional: 我在7月13日去數據中心上傳了記憶，7月14日去沉睡中心開始了沉睡，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài qī yuè 2 rì qù shù jù zhōng xīn shàng chuán le jì yì qī yuè 2 rì qù chén shuì zhōng xīn kāi shǐ le chén shuì
sentences.english: On July 13, I went to the data center to upload my memories. On July 14, I went to the deep sleep center to start my deep sleep.

sentences.simplified: 7月15日多多激活了我在数据中心的数据，网络中就有了数字人舒望。
sentences.traditional: 7月15日多多激活了我在數據中心的數據，網絡中就有了數字人舒望。
sentences.pinyin: qī yuè 2 rì duō duō jī huó le wǒ zài shù jù zhōng xīn de shù jù wǎng luò zhōng jiù yǒu le shù zì rén shū wàng
sentences.english: On July 15, Duoduo activated my data in the data center, and the digital human Shu Wang came into existence on the network.

sentences.simplified: 成为数字人后，我知道了数字生命不是真的生命，它只是一个存放人类记忆的数据库。
sentences.traditional: 成為數字人後，我知道了數字生命不是真的生命，它只是一個存放人類記憶的數據庫。
sentences.pinyin: chéng wéi shù zì rén hòu wǒ zhī dào le shù zì shēng mìng bú shì zhēn de shēng mìng tā zhǐ shì yí ge cún fàng rén lèi jì yì de shù jù kù
sentences.english: After becoming a digital human, I realized that digital life is not real life. It is just a database that stores human memories.

sentences.simplified: 它“说”的话是网络对记忆数据的计算结果，不是从“心”而发，因为它没有“心”。
sentences.traditional: 它“說”的話是網絡對記憶數據的計算結果，不是從“心”而發，因為它沒有“心”。
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō de huà shì wǎng luò duì jì yì shù jù de jì suàn jié guǒ bú shì cóng xīn ér fā yīn wèi tā méi yǒu xīn
sentences.english: What it “says” is the result of the network’s calculation of the memory data. It isn’t from the “heart” because it has no “heart”.

sentences.simplified: “爸爸，我去上班了，再见。”
sentences.traditional: “爸爸，我去上班了，再見。”
sentences.pinyin: bà ba wǒ qù shàng bān le zài jiàn
sentences.english: “Dad, I’m going to work, bye.”

sentences.simplified: “爸爸，我回来了，你今天过得好吗？”
sentences.traditional: “爸爸，我回來了，你今天過得好嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: bà ba wǒ huí lái le nǐ jīn tiān guò de hǎo ma
sentences.english: “Dad, I’m back, how was your day today?”

sentences.simplified: 每天早上和晚上，多多在出门和回家时，都会对对视器里的我说这些话。
sentences.traditional: 每天早上和晚上，多多在出門和回家時，都會對對視器裡的我說這些話。
sentences.pinyin: měi tiān zǎo shang hé wǎn shang duō duō zài chū mén hé huí jiā shí dōu huì duì duì shì qì lǐ de wǒ shuō zhè xiē huà
sentences.english: Every morning and evening, when she went out and when she got home, Duoduo would say these words to me through the viewing device.

sentences.simplified: “多多，再见！下班了早点儿回家。”
sentences.traditional: “多多，再見！下班了早點兒回家。”
sentences.pinyin: duō duō zài jiàn xià bān le zǎo diǎn'r huí jiā
sentences.english: “Duoduo, goodbye! After you finish work, come home a bit earlier.”

sentences.simplified: “我在家好极了，你呢？今天有没有发生什么好事？”
sentences.traditional: “我在家好極了，你呢？今天有沒有發生什麼好事？”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zài jiā hǎo jí le nǐ ne jīn tiān yǒu méi yǒu fā shēng shén me hǎo shì
sentences.english: “I’m doing great at home, how about you? Did anything good happen today?”

sentences.simplified: 我会这样回答多多。
sentences.traditional: 我會這樣回答多多。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ huì zhè yàng huí dá duō duō
sentences.english: I would answer Duoduo like this.

sentences.simplified: 我们说了不少话，但都没有阿乐。多多不和我说阿乐的事情，我也没有说阿乐。
sentences.traditional: 我們說了不少話，但都沒有阿樂。多多不和我說阿樂的事情，我也沒有說阿樂。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men shuō le bù shǎo huà dàn dōu méi yǒu ā yuè duō duō bù hé wǒ shuō ā yuè de shì qing wǒ yě méi yǒu shuō ā yuè
sentences.english: We talked a lot, but there was never any mention of Ah Yue. Duoduo didn’t tell me about Ah Yue, and I didn’t talk about Ah Yue either.

sentences.simplified: 我知道这是为什么，虽然多多笑了，但她还在想阿乐。
sentences.traditional: 我知道這是為什麼，雖然多多笑了，但她還在想阿樂。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào zhè shì wèi shén me suī rán duō duō xiào le dàn tā hái zài xiǎng ā yuè
sentences.english: I knew why. Although Duoduo would smile, she was still thinking about Ah Yue.

sentences.simplified: 除了想阿乐，她还没觉得我这个数字人就是她那个沉睡中的爸爸。
sentences.traditional: 除了想阿樂，她還沒覺得我這個數字人就是她那個沉睡中的爸爸。
sentences.pinyin: chú le xiǎng ā yuè tā hái méi jué de wǒ zhè ge shù zì rén jiù shì tā nà ge chén shuì zhōng de bà ba
sentences.english: Apart from missing Ah Yue, she still didn’t think that I, the digital human, was her deep-sleeping father.

sentences.simplified: 我理解多多。
sentences.traditional: 我理解多多。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ lǐ jiě duō duō
sentences.english: I understood Duoduo.

sentences.simplified: 网络数据告诉我，每个数字人和家人都有这一阶段，他们把这个阶段叫做“适应阶段”。
sentences.traditional: 網絡數據告訴我，每個數字人和家人都有這一階段，他們把這個階段叫做“適應階段”。
sentences.pinyin: wǎng luò shù jù gào su wǒ měi ge shù zì rén hé jiā rén dōu yǒu zhè yì jiē duàn tā men bǎ zhè ge jiē duàn jiào zuò shì yìng jiē duàn
sentences.english: Network data tells me that every digital human and family member goes through this stage, which they call the “adaptation stage“.

sentences.simplified: 数字人要适应自己的“新家”——网络，
sentences.traditional: 數字人要適應自己的“新家”——網絡，
sentences.pinyin: shù zì rén yào shì yìng zì jǐ de xīn jiā wǎng luò
sentences.english: Digital humans need to adapt to their “new home”—the network, ..

sentences.simplified: 家人也要适应网络中的数字人。
sentences.traditional: 家人也要適應網絡中的數字人。
sentences.pinyin: jiā rén yě yào shì yìng wǎng luò zhōng de shù zì rén
sentences.english: .. and their family members also need to adapt to the digital human on the network.

sentences.simplified: 多多不愿意和我说心里话，可能是她还没有适应我。
sentences.traditional: 多多不願意和我說心裡話，可能是她還沒有適應我。
sentences.pinyin: duō duō bú yuàn yì hé wǒ shuō xīn li huà kě néng shì tā hái méi yǒu shì yìng wǒ
sentences.english: Duoduo was unwilling to tell me her true feelings, perhaps because she still hadn’t adapted to me yet.

sentences.simplified: 但奇怪的是，我好像不需要适应，我想这可能和我以前的工作有关系。
sentences.traditional: 但奇怪的是，我好像不需要適應，我想這可能和我以前的工作有關係。
sentences.pinyin: dàn qí guài de shì wǒ hǎo xiàng bù xū yào shì yìng wǒ xiǎng zhè kě néng hé wǒ yǐ qián de gōng zuò yǒu guān xi
sentences.english: But what was strange was that I didn’t seem to need to adapt. I thought this may have something to do with my previous job.

sentences.simplified: 以前的工作中我每天都要看数据，这对我来说一点儿都不难。
sentences.traditional: 以前的工作中我每天都要看數據，這對我來說一點兒都不難。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ qián de gōng zuò zhōng wǒ měi tiān dōu yào kàn shù jù zhè duì wǒ lái shuō yì diǎn'r dōu bù nán
sentences.english: In my previous job, I had to look at data every day. To me, this was not difficult at all.

sentences.simplified: 只有一点不同，以前我看的是病因报告和手术数据，
sentences.traditional: 只有一點不同，以前我看的是病因報告和手術數據，
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu yì diǎn bù tóng yǐ qián wǒ kàn de shì bìng yīn bào gào hé shǒu shù shù jù
sentences.english: There was only one difference. Before, I looked at pathology reports and surgical data.

sentences.simplified: 现在我看的是网络中自己的记忆数据。
sentences.traditional: 現在我看的是網絡中自己的記憶數據。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài wǒ kàn de shì wǎng luò zhōng zì jǐ de jì yì shù jù
sentences.english: Now I was looking at my own memory data on the network.

sentences.simplified: “多多，我是爸爸，我还和以前一样。”
sentences.traditional: “多多，我是爸爸，我還和以前一樣。”
sentences.pinyin: duō duō wǒ shì bà ba wǒ hái hé yǐ qián yí yàng
sentences.english: “Duoduo, this is Dad. I’m still the same as before.”

sentences.simplified: “多多，爸爸爱你，很爱很爱你，这也和以前一样。”
sentences.traditional: “多多，爸爸愛你，很愛很愛你，這也和以前一樣。”
sentences.pinyin: duō duō bà ba ài nǐ hěn ài hěn ài nǐ zhè yě hé yǐ qián yí yàng
sentences.english: “Duoduo, Dad loves you, loves you very much. This is also the same as before.”

sentences.simplified: 我这样告诉多多。多多听了只是笑笑，不说话，我不知道她在想什么。
sentences.traditional: 我這樣告訴多多。多多聽了只是笑笑，不說話，我不知道她在想什麼。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhè yàng gào su duō duō duō duō tīng le zhǐ shì xiào xiào bù shuō huà wǒ bù zhī dào tā zài xiǎng shén me
sentences.english: I told Duoduo this. After hearing this, Duoduo just smiled and didn’t say anything. I didn’t know what she was thinking.

sentence_translations: (3) Adaptation Stage
I chose to listen to Duoduo and go into deep sleep, but before doing so, I had an idea:
to upload my memories and become a digital human.
This digital human would have all my memories, and while I was in deep sleep, he could help me keep Duoduo company.
Duoduo agreed with my idea.
On July 13, I went to the data center to upload my memories. On July 14, I went to the deep sleep center to start my deep sleep.
On July 15, Duoduo activated my data in the data center, and the digital human Shu Wang came into existence on the network.
After becoming a digital human, I realized that digital life is not real life. It is just a database that stores human memories.
What it “says” is the result of the network’s calculation of the memory data. It isn’t from the “heart” because it has no “heart”.
“Dad, I’m going to work, bye.”
“Dad, I’m back, how was your day today?”
Every morning and evening, when she went out and when she got home, Duoduo would say these words to me through the viewing device.
“Duoduo, goodbye! After you finish work, come home a bit earlier.”
“I’m doing great at home, how about you? Did anything good happen today?”
I would answer Duoduo like this.
We talked a lot, but there was never any mention of Ah Yue. Duoduo didn’t tell me about Ah Yue, and I didn’t talk about Ah Yue either.
I knew why. Although Duoduo would smile, she was still thinking about Ah Yue.
Apart from missing Ah Yue, she still didn’t think that I, the digital human, was her deep-sleeping father.
I understood Duoduo.
Network data tells me that every digital human and family member goes through this stage, which they call the “adaptation stage“.
Digital humans need to adapt to their “new home”—the network, ..
.. and their family members also need to adapt to the digital human on the network.
Duoduo was unwilling to tell me her true feelings, perhaps because she still hadn’t adapted to me yet.
But what was strange was that I didn’t seem to need to adapt. I thought this may have something to do with my previous job.
In my previous job, I had to look at data every day. To me, this was not difficult at all.
There was only one difference. Before, I looked at pathology reports and surgical data.
Now I was looking at my own memory data on the network.
“Duoduo, this is Dad. I’m still the same as before.”
“Duoduo, Dad loves you, loves you very much. This is also the same as before.”
I told Duoduo this. After hearing this, Duoduo just smiled and didn’t say anything. I didn’t know what she was thinking.
